item: Home briefing: the two measured slow producers run last in the card audit; coverage_advisor reads its window once (F8)
summary: On the 2026-11-07 bundle space_time_convergence (225.6 s) and coverage_advisor (35.0 s), both no-signal, spent 261 of the 300 s statement budget so 25 of 38 producers read skipped-budget. Both join _RUN_LAST (new _SLOW_SCAN_PRODUCERS; not trending callers, so they still run without the rollup). coverage_advisor's three scans of the 30-day window (per-column share, per-column recount) become one grouped query; counts and cards unchanged. Not done: space_time_convergence's own cost (the _shared_origin query, F2, owned by the trending-insights thread); the 57 h stale cache from the pass-tail give-up (scheduler, WAL lane); production run_all order is unchanged.
